object_description: precisely sited two-story building volume with central atriums
design_condition: Precisely positioned beside the existing gymnasium and connected to the existing break area, the building preserves the ensemble's hierarchy and trees but produces minimal peripheral outdoor space.

positive.statement: The precise setting enables a direct connection to the existing break area and strengthens integration into the heterogeneous ensemble.
The spacious covered forecourt solves the corner entrance situation in a plausible and simple way.
The clear structure provides an optimal distribution of space and a good atmosphere on entry.
The atriums form the heart of the building and create a pleasant and liberating learning atmosphere.
The arrangement of classrooms with group rooms in between enables maximum flexibility of use.
The parapet elements ensure appropriate and true-to-scale proportioning of the overall volume.
The project has good economic viability and meets the basic sustainability requirements.

negative.statement: The two-story volume requires a large floor area and generates minimal outdoor areas.
The covered connection to the existing buildings is not convincing and hardly strengthens the access situation.
The required accessibility for disabled people is not clear from the plans.
The schematic treatment of the surrounding area does not demonstrate the possible usage qualities of the outdoor spaces.
The spatial connection of the basement workrooms, the lift, and the kindergarten and day-school layout are not convincing.
